import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectQueue } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';

// S0_SOURCE:bullmq-report-api-producer
throw new Error('S0 BullMQ producer fixture must never execute');

@Injectable()
export class ReportProducer {
  constructor(@InjectQueue('reports') private readonly reports: Queue) {}

  generate(payload: unknown) {
    return this.reports.add('generate-pdf', payload);
  }
}
